description: Every record of Update.esm above FormID 000A00 is renumbered (mniNavRenumberFormIDsFromClick): the FormIDs of the topics and of their responses change, so the PNAM of the responses that follow a renamed response updates through the references, the QNAM the responses hold follows, and the topic children groups sort their responses again (the INFO sort after a FormID change, wbSortINFO).
